the antioxidant activities of the extracts of the grains, and the antioxidant activity and mineral content of the extracts of their flours were significantly affected by their processing.

the development of a simple, sensitive and selective method for the determination of total antioxidant activity in grains.
the antioxidant activity and the mineral content of unprocessed and cooked pearl millet, sor-gum and mung beans.
the development and evaluation of the antioxidant properties and functional properties of pearl millet flour (PMF) and its blends with wheat and sorghum flours.
